summary.intent: Plan, execute, and ship phase 63 (Read-Chain Navigation and Rotation Core) of CipherBox autonomously while the user was AFK.
summary.outcome: Planning completed fully (7 plans, 4 waves, verification passed on iteration 2). Execution completed waves 1–2 (5/7 plans done); wave 3 (63-06) was interrupted by a weekly usage limit with a clean tree, and a retry was dispatched at session end. Wave 4 and /ship-phase were not reached.

repo: sdk-core has no `typecheck` script; the real type gate is `build` (runs `tsup && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json`). Plans 63-05 and 63-06 referenced a non-existent `typecheck` script and had to be redirected.
API health endpoint is `/health` on port 3000; CI already polls it with `curl -fsS http://localhost:3000/health` in a bounded loop — safe replacement pattern for `sleep N` in E2E plans.
Commit signing was already disabled repo-locally (`commit.gpgsign: false`); no action needed before autonomous AFK runs.
The GSD commit helper consistently reports false-negatives (exit non-zero) but commits do land — verified via `git log`. Don't treat helper exit code as authoritative.

Full sdk-core test suite baseline after wave 2: 261 passed, 52 skipped. The 29 skips in folder.test.ts are a mix of legitimately deferred blocks and newly-stale TODO(phase 63) blocks left by executors.
Worktree execution was skipped due to documented project pitfalls (node_modules leaks, api:generate conflicts) and tight cross-plan coupling (shared folder.test.ts between waves 1 and 2).

code.finding: Stale `describe.skip('Folder operations', ... TODO(phase 63))` block — added by a prior phase, should be assessed and either deleted or ported now that phase 63 added active coverage.
Stale `describe.skip('updateFolderMetadataAndPublish conflict handling', ... TODO(phase 63))` — conflict handling scenario, verify new active blocks cover this before deleting.
Stale `describe.skip('zeroization decision guard (S3/D-05)', ... TODO(phase 63))` — security-relevant invariant; must confirm new blocks cover it before removal.
Stale `describe.skip('createSubfolder', ... TODO(phase 63))` — assess coverage and remove or port.
Rotation engine (`rotateReadFromNode`/`rotateOne`) written in 63-03: 513 lines, 83% coverage, 18 tests, 4 named Phase-64 seams stubbed in place.

workflow: GSD plan-phase checker pass 1 returned 1 blocker + 2 warnings — all artifact-level (RESEARCH.md open-questions heading, unfilled VALIDATION.md template, fragile `sleep 12`), not design flaws. All fixed deterministically without replanning; pass 2 was clean.

When a subagent hits a usage limit mid-wave on a sequential in-tree execution model, the working tree stays clean if no partial file edits were made — atomic commit discipline makes resumption straightforward.
Weekly usage limits reset at 7am Europe/Berlin; timing a retry immediately after reset is a viable recovery path.
Drift gate (stale codebase map) is non-blocking at plan time when CONTEXT.md and RESEARCH.md carry verified current implementation-site references.
Pattern mapper returned 10/10 analogs before planning — useful signal that the planner had strong precedent to draw from.

friction: Weekly usage limit hit mid-wave 3 (63-06 executor), interrupting execution before any changes were made.
GSD commit helper false-negatives on every commit required manual `git log` verification to confirm commits landed — adds noise to every wave checkpoint.
Plans 63-05 and 63-06 referenced a `typecheck` script that does not exist in sdk-core; executors had to be redirected to `build` at dispatch time rather than catching this during planning.

Plan checker flagged unfilled VALIDATION.md body as a warning even though step 5.5 of the workflow explicitly says the body is populated during planning, not by the orchestrator at template-write time.
open_items: Wave 3 (63-06): delete `reWrapForRecipients` and rewire sdk client `addItem` — retry dispatched at session end, outcome unknown.
Wave 4 (63-07): live sdk-e2e round-trip (grant→navigate→rotate→revoked) — not started.

Assess 4 stale `describe.skip(... TODO(phase 63))` blocks in folder.test.ts (L114, L257, L454, L878); confirm new active test blocks cover conflict handling and zeroization guard (S3/D-05), then delete or port.
Phase 64 seams in engine.ts are named stubs — implementation deferred to next phase by design.
